protocol.foreground_CPU_note: total CPU and owned CPU are retained; background is their estimated difference. CPU threshold applies to timed request intervals; CPU peaks in bookkeeping are diagnostic.
protocol.GPU_rule: Any observed foreign GPU activity invalidates the whole arm. Only WindowServer is excluded; no ambient-process exemptions.
protocol.paging_rule: Any pageout, swapin or swapout increment over an arm or request invalidates it.
protocol.power_rule: IOPS AC source and NSProcessInfo low-power/thermal checked throughout and at every endpoint; pmset automatic mode checked before/after each arm.
protocol.retry_rule: Predeclared cap of 3 attempts per pair. Repeat both arms after an environment failure. Keep the first fully valid pair, discard its failed counterparts as a pair. No selection by rate. No retry for output/cache/shape errors.
protocol.warmups: Distinct 2.9K greedy input (64 tokens), short greedy coding input (512), and 4K sampled input (64), then quiet wait. Slot eviction before every measured request; zero cached tokens required.
protocol.metric: Unchanged bench/harness/bench.py decode_rates: (completion_tokens - 1)/(last content event - first content event).
protocol.aggregation: Each arm mean has two requests per case. Headline compares the mean of the 12 requests per build/case. Same-build spread is the range of six arm means divided by their mean; the descriptive paired t interval uses six arm-pair differences (df=5), not twelve independent requests.
